svg.aria-label: Incremental view maintenance. Instead of recomputing a query over all data, a streaming engine such as Materialize, RisingWave or Feldera reads the change stream from the database and updates the stored result by applying only each change: a new order adds its amount to the customer's total. Reads of the view are instant and always fresh to within the stream lag.

svg.text: App reads the view: instant, fresh
